items.name: STMHS Spring 2019

venue.name: Science and Technology Magnet High School of Southeastern Connecticut
venue.address: Science and Technology Magnet High School, 490 Jefferson Ave, New London, CT 06320
venue.details: In the lecture hall on the first floor of STMHS, enter through leftmost door and take a left.

items.information: **UPDATE** (March 9): The competition has reached the 60-competitor limit, and a number of people now have registrations on the waiting list. Registration has now been closed. In the event of any cancellation, we will accept people from the waiting list in the order in which they have paid the registration fee. STMHS is holding its first WCA competition in May! This competition is planned to help lower the costs of graduation caps and gowns for seniors in STMHS and bring some love to Connecticut cubing. (And then some!) The events consist of some NxNxN puzzles (2x2 up to 5x5, including 3x3 Blindfolded) as well as more unorthodox puzzles (Skewb, Square-1, Pyraminx). 2x2 and 3x3 will have two rounds while the rest of the events will only have one round. Guests are welcome, though it will be appreciated to inform us on how many each competitor will plan on having with them on their registration forms. To the right of the venue is New London High School which has a free parking lot, though its capacity becoming full throughout the day is unknown.

items.information: Перед подачей заявки ознакомьтесь с информацией о регистрации. Если вы ознакомились с условиями регистрации и условиями оплаты взноса, то вы можете перейти к регистрации. После регистрации на сайте вам нужно оплатить участие. _____ Before submitting the application, read the registration information. Registration with incorrect first and last name, as well as date of birth will not be accepted, please carefully check the entered data. Submitting an application and paying a participation fee means that you acquainted and agree with the rules of the competition.
